Signed-down state; bottom-20% prior loss; next-open entry; 20-session hold; veto causal abnormal volume at or above the 60th percentile.
Broad asset and sector separation plus severity-matched TRAIN separation; the frozen cross-sectional veto gates passed.

Decide whether a genuinely new stabilizing hypothesis is worth a separately frozen test; do not rescue this rule with more post-hoc filters.

Positive completed returns may carry more positive forward dependence when the path is inefficient/sideways or movement capacity is low-to-moderate; efficient trending paths more often show gain exhaustion.
No trading rule. Descriptive comparison of the positive-prior branch across fixed prior/forward horizons and frozen ER20 / ATR% states.
TSLA shows a weak 5-10-session continuation ridge; the 129-instrument atlas shows broad positive gain-branch signs in ER20-sideways cells and negative signs in ER20-trending cells.
Point estimates are small, windows overlap, TSLA motivated the lane, and no single representative rule or fresh replication has been frozen.
Choose one narrative-first representative comparison before any new calculation; then freeze timing, state, baseline, and failure rule.
